title: AmTRAN Video Recalls to Repair 42-Inch JVC Flat Panel Televisions Due to Risk of Tip Over
summary: The neck of the stand can crack and cause the television to tip over unexpectedly, posing a risk of impact injury to the consumer. Units: About 27,000.

title: FGX International Recalls Children's Sunglasses Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the sunglasses contains excessive levels of lead, which is prohibited under federal law. Units: About 215,000.

title: Livie & Luca Recalls Children's Shoes Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: A metal thread inside the interior shoe liner can loosen and poke through the shoe lining, posing a laceration hazard to the user. Units: 5600.

title: Yamaha Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel hose joint can leak during operation, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,520.

title: Great Innovations Recalls Humidifiers Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively by QVC (Recall Alert)
summary: Water can enter the base and cause the circuit board to short circuit and overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 70,000.

title: iDevices Recalls Temperature Probes Due to Ingestion Hazard
summary: The plastic insulator located inside the stainless steel probe is not heat resistant and can melt and fall into food, posing an ingestion hazard. Units: About 48,500 in the U.S. and 510 in Canada.

title: Orbea Recalls Avant Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle front fork can crack, posing a fall hazard. Units: 715.

title: Tray Vous Recalls Snack and Activity Trays for Strollers Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The opening between the recalled tray and stroller seat bottom allows an unharnessed child's body to pass through but could trap a child's head, posing a strangulation hazard. Units: About 770 in the United States and 90 in Canada.

title: Siemens Recalls Audible Fire Alarm Base Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The fire alarm base can fail to sound an alarm, posing a risk of personal injury and property damage. Units: About 9,000.

title: IKEA Recalls Children's Swing Due To Fall Hazard
summary: The suspension fittings can break causing a child to fall from the swing, posing a risk of serious injury. Units: About 2,000 in the United States and 300 in Canada.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Side by Sides Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Oil can leak from the oil cooler lines, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,600.

title: Kidde Recalls Smoke and Combination Smoke/CO Alarms Due to Alarm Failure
summary: The alarms could fail to alert consumers of a fire or a CO incident following a power outage. Units: About 1.2 million in the United States and about 112,000 in Canada.

title: American Honda Recalls Gas-Powered Generators Due to Impact Hazard and Owner’s Manual Error (Recall Alert)
summary: The rear frame support can fail during lifting, posing an impact hazard. The owner's manual can have missing or duplicated pages, which could cause consumers not to receive important operating or safety information. Units: About 8,100.

title: Benetton Recalls United Colors of Benetton Boys Jackets; Waist Drawstring Poses Entanglement Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring at the waist that could become snagged or caught in small spaces or vehicle doors, posing significant entanglement hazard to children. Units: About 93.

title: Coleman Recalls Inflatable Rubber River Tubes Due to Skin Irritation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: Contact with the tube can cause skin irritation. Units: About 20,500.

title: Cabrinha Recalls Kiteboarding Control System Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The Recoil™ spring on the control mechanism can jam, leading to a loss of control, which poses a risk of injury. Units: About 1,700.

title: Active Apparel Recalls Boys Fission Zipper Hooded Sweatshirts Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have drawstrings around the neck area which pose a strangulation hazard to children. Drawstrings can become entangled or caught on playground slides, hand rails, school bus doors or other moving objects, posing a significant strangulation or an entanglement hazard to children. title: Franklin Fueling Systems Recalls Hardwall Fuel Curb Hose Due to Fire and Explosion Hazard
summary: The crimp on the fuel hose can loosen causing fuel to leak, posing a fire and explosion hazard. Units: About 6,700.

title: Husqvarna Recalls Craftsman Push Mowers Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Orchard Supply Hardware (Recall Alert)
summary: The engine control/bail lever on the handle can fail, allowing the engine to run and the blades to rotate, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 700.

title: Pure Baby Organics Boys Hoodie Recalled by Chantique's Corp. Due To Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweaters have a drawstring around the neck area which poses a strangulation hazard to children. title: Trimfoot Recalls Children's Soft-Soled Sneakers Due to Choking Hazard; Sold exclusively at Macy's
summary: A small metal eyelet can detach from the inside of the sneaker, posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: 5300.

title: Bad Boy Buggies Recalls Recreational Off-Road Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: Incorrect parking brake adjustments and improperly bled brake lines can diminish a consumer's braking ability, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 4,460.

title: Ross Stores Recalls Bistro Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair's seat can fail to attach to the frame when the chair is unfolded, causing the chair to collapse. This poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 840.

title: Shivvers Recalls Country Clipper Riding Lawn Mowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The ignition module can fail to ground, resulting in overheating and melting, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,650 in the U.S. and 261 in Canada.

title: Hearth & Home Technologies Recalls Gas Fireplaces, Stoves, Inserts and Log Sets Due to Risk of Gas Leak and Fire Hazard
summary: The gas valve in the unit can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 20,000.
